prompt: Create a static choropleth PNG of burned area by Portuguese district using the provided wildfire CSV and mainland shapefile. Include a clear title and legend.
Create a static choropleth PNG of number of fires by Portuguese district. Use an appropriate sequential color ramp, title, legend, and source note.
Create a static choropleth PNG of burned area with district boundaries, title, legend, source note, and a diagnostic JSON reporting input rows, output rows, CRS, and invalid geometries.
Create a choropleth map after detecting and setting missing CRS metadata for the mainland shapefile when necessary. Save a diagnostic JSON documenting CRS handling.
Repair invalid geometries before joining and rendering a burned-area choropleth. Report invalid geometry counts before and after repair in a diagnostic JSON.
Join wildfire attributes to district geometry using the correct key, render a burned-area choropleth, and report unmatched records and missing values in a diagnostic JSON.

Attempt to map burned area, but first validate that the expected burned-area column exists. If the obvious column name is wrong, detect the closest available column and report the correction instead of crashing.
Create a burned-area choropleth with five quantile classes. Save the map and a diagnostic JSON listing class breaks.
Create a color-blind-safe choropleth of burned area. Include title, legend, and source note, and record the chosen color ramp in a diagnostic JSON.
Create an interactive Folium choropleth with tooltips for district, burned area, and number of fires. Save an HTML file.
Create both a static PNG and an interactive HTML choropleth from the same cleaned data. Include a diagnostic JSON for CRS, geometry repair, and join status.
Plot a time series of annual burned area from 2002 to 2022 and identify the maximum burned-area year in a diagnostic JSON.
